DIGEST: lease.txt and notice.txt (text copies; no page numbers in either, so cites are clause or paragraph numbers)

LEASE AGREEMENT (lease.txt)
- Type: commercial lease of Unit 4, Tarrow Arcade, Pemberton. Dated 3 March 2025.
- Parties: Landlord Halvard Quince Properties Ltd, 12 Orrin Lane, Pemberton. Tenant Mirelle Dask Bakery Ltd, Unit 4, Tarrow Arcade.
- Execution: text shows "Signed: H. Quince (for the Landlord)", "Signed: M. Dask (for the Tenant)", witness Corin Abbet. Signatures are typed names only in the copy; cannot confirm wet or e-signature.
- Term (cl. 2.1): five years, 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2030. Note the lease is dated before the term starts.
- Tenant break (cl. 2.2): on 31 March 2028 on six months' written notice. Notice deadline is 30 Sept 2027 (derived, not stated).
- Rent (cl. 3.1): 24,000 per year, monthly in advance on the 1st (2,000 per month, consistent with notice).
- Late interest (cl. 3.2): 4% above base rate, if unpaid 14 days after due date.
- Rent review (cl. 3.3): upward only, on 1 April 2027. No review mechanism or amount stated.
- Deposit (cl. 4.1): 6,000 on signing. Return within 30 days after term ends, less lawful deductions (cl. 4.2).
- Premises (cl. 1.1, 1.2): Unit 4 including rear store room, "but not the yard".
- Repairs (cl. 5.1-5.3): Tenant keeps interior in repair; Landlord repairs roof, structure, common parts; Landlord must start roof repairs within 21 days of written notice of defect.
- Use (cl. 6.1, 6.2): bakery with retail counter only; no baking 23:00 to 05:00.
- Forfeiture (cl. 7.1): re-entry if rent is 21 days in arrears after a written demand. Cl. 7.2: "Re-entry needs 14 days' prior written notice to the Tenant."
- Notices (cl. 8.1): in writing, by hand or recorded post, to the addresses above. Email is not a listed method.

NOTICE OF ARREARS AND INTENDED RE-ENTRY (notice.txt)
- Type: letter of arrears demand and intended re-entry. Dated 2 September 2025.
- From Halvard Quince Properties Ltd to Mirelle Dask Bakery Ltd. Delivered by hand (header).
- Signed "Halvard Quince, Director" (typed name only in copy).
- Arrears (paras 2-5): 2,000 each for 1 July, 1 August and 1 September 2025; total 6,000. Interest claimed at 4% above base rate under cl. 3.2 (para 6), no amount stated.
- Demand (para 7): states it is a written demand for cl. 7.1.
- Intended re-entry (para 8): "Unless the arrears are paid within 7 days, we intend to re-enter the Premises."
- Yard (paras 9-11): says yard used for flour sacks; para 10 concedes yard is not part of the Premises (cl. 1.2); para 11 demands clearance within 7 days.
- Reservation (para 12): reserves rights "including to keep the deposit".
- Payment (para 13): "to the account on file" (no account details). Reply to 12 Orrin Lane (para 14).
- Footer: "Note on file: copy sent by email only to the Tenant's accountant."

ISSUES AND INCONSISTENCIES
- Re-entry timing: para 8 gives 7 days; cl. 7.2 requires 14 days' prior written notice. The notice period is shorter than the lease requires.
- Arrears period: cl. 7.1 requires rent 21 days in arrears after the written demand. The 1 September rent was due the day before the letter (2 Sept), so the 21-day condition appears not met on the face of the letter. Demand and arrears timing should be checked.
- Yard: para 11 demands clearance of the yard, but cl. 1.2 excludes the yard from the Premises. The yard demand has no clear basis in the lease; the lease contains no yard clause.
- Service: notice says delivered by hand (compliant with cl. 8.1). The email copy to the Tenant's accountant is not a cl. 8.1 method and is not service on the Tenant.
- Deposit: para 12 reserves right to keep deposit; cl. 4.2 allows return only after term ends, less lawful deductions. No rent arrears deduction is expressly authorised in the lease.
- Interest: para 6 claims interest under cl. 3.2 without calculating it.
- Rent periods: lease says rent is payable from term start (1 April 2025); the notice starts arrears at 1 July 2025. Rent for April-June 2025 is not addressed in either document.
- Lease date 3 March 2025 precedes term start 1 April 2025 (not inconsistent, but noted).

KEY QUOTES
1. "Re-entry needs 14 days' prior written notice to the Tenant." (lease, cl. 7.2)
2. "Unless the arrears are paid within 7 days, we intend to re-enter the Premises." (notice, para 8)
3. "The Premises include the rear store room but not the yard." (lease, cl. 1.2)
4. "The yard is not part of the Premises (clause 1.2)." (notice, para 10)
5. "This letter is a written demand for the purposes of clause 7.1." (notice, para 7)

Both text copies are legible. No garbling noted. Original PDFs were not opened.
